purpose: Finish the prospect lane with page-level evidence that the requesting sandbox cannot retrieve. Results feed compileProspectVerification (src/prospect-verification-intake.mjs); do not hand-pick a winner.
stopCondition: Stop when at least one candidate returns VERIFIED_CANDIDATE, or when every candidate and every discovery lead below has been falsified or exhausted.
evidenceClassToReturn: PAGE_FETCH_VERIFIED. A search-engine summary or second-hand report can never produce VERIFIED_CANDIDATE.
rules: Public pages only. No logins, form submissions, CAPTCHA or access-control bypass.
Record the exact page URL, the verbatim excerpt (must contain the address) and the observation time for every address.
Never guess or pattern-infer an address. Never use an incidental internal address from a blog or transcript.
A privacy, legal, careers, abuse or customer-support address is not a sales recipient.
Check contact page, footer, terms and privacy for anti-solicitation, no-vendor, consent-required or no-harvest statements. Report presence as a negativeRecipientSignal.
Also check the agency's own articles/services for a published stance against unsolicited marketing or optimization reports.
Confirm current ownership. If part of a larger group, fill parentAssessment (operatesUnderOwnBrand, parentOverlapWithOffer, rationale, evidenceRef).

Identify one CURRENT, publicly attributable home-service client and investigate that client's public lead path. Report only factual, observable issues (form path failure, dead appointment link, missing or buried CTA, inconsistent phone routing, intent/destination mismatch, contradictory hours, duplicated conversion paths, tracking gap visible from the public flow). If none: NO_ACTIONABLE_PUBLIC_LEAK_OBSERVED and move on.
Do not invent an issue because the offer expects one.
Check each recipient address against excludeAlreadyContacted.

Choose the offer from the existing quartet only: AGENCY_REVENUE_LEAK_PROOF_PACK, AI_AGENT_PRODUCTION_RELEASE_GATE, REVENUE_PROOF_AND_RENEWAL_PACK, GCC_BOOKING_PARITY_SPRINT. Give a reason of at least one sentence.
